leadText: Moro Island (Japanese: スダチ島 Sudachi Island) is located in the southeastern region of the Orange Islands. It featured in the episode A Shipful of Shivers. The island has a museum dedicated to the history of the Orange League. An Officer Jenny patrols the island for any criminals.
plainText:
Moro Island (Japanese: スダチ島 Sudachi Island) is located in the southeastern region of the Orange Islands. It featured in the episode A Shipful of Shivers. The island has a museum dedicated to the history of the Orange League. An Officer Jenny patrols the island for any criminals.

==Places of interest==
===Pokémon Center===
 
Moro Island's Pokémon Center overlooks the coast and is run by a Nurse Joy.

===Moro Island Museum of Art===
Moro Island's main attraction is the Museum of Art. Inside, the museum is filled with old paintings, sculptures, and artefacts. In the back of the museum, an Orange League Winner's Trophy had been recovered from a sunken ship and was put on display. later stole the trophy, though and returned to its rightful place, the Ghost ship.

===Ghost ship===
 
The Ghost ship is a 300-year-old shipwreck that was recently discovered off the coast of Moro Island. The resident Pokémon moved the ship after the Winner's Trophy that its won was removed from it.
